title: What do you check during air condition maintenance?
desc: Lubricate moving parts, Check thermostat settings, Inspect, and clean the air filter or replace it, if it is deteriorated and can’t be used further, Tighten all electrical connection, Check system control

title: How does outside temperature affect an air conditioner?
desc: warmer outdoor temperatures force your AC to work harder to extract heat from your house, lowering efficiency and raising energy bills. It may also put stress on the system and reduce its lifespan

title: What is the ideal AC temperature for kids?
desc: The best temperature for babies is between 68 to 72 degrees Fahrenheit or 20 to 22 degrees Celsius.| By Khatab, Technicians of FAJ
